record_title: Exact one-row frontier from separability to disjunctness
provenance: An explicit infinite family proving the exact worst-case one-row conversion frontier G(s)=floor(s/2) from exact s-separability to disjunctness, sharpening the Chen--Hwang conversion theorem.
limitations: The result concerns noiseless binary matrices and one-row augmentation. It does not optimize witness row count, classify extremal examples, or address error-tolerant variants. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from equivalent set-system or superimposed-code terminology.
